product.name: Mirror AI
product.description: An app that creates personalized cartoon avatars and generates over 1000 emoji stickers from a single selfie for use in messaging apps.

product.name: Mirror AI Emoji Keyboard
product.description: A mobile keyboard app providing quick access to personalized emoji stickers created with Mirror AI for use in messaging.

product.name: Sticker Pack Creator
product.description: A feature that enables users to create custom sticker packs for use in messaging apps like WhatsApp and Telegram.

product.name: Business Mirror API and Services
product.description: An API and service offering that enables businesses to integrate personalized cartoon avatars and emoji stickers into their communication platforms.
